name: Move and resize own window
plain: Moves or resizes a popup the site opened; ignored for normal tabs.
meaning: A site can reshape a popup it created, but the browser blocks changes to tabs and pre-existing windows, so scripts cannot yank your main window around or hide it off screen.

web.api: win.moveTo(x, y); win.resizeTo(w, h); win.moveBy(dx, dy)

access.persistence: Per window; applies once, no stored state
access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Same rules in iframes: only a window the script opened can be moved or resized
steps: Page opens a popup with window.open
Script calls moveTo or resizeTo on the popup reference

limits.headline: Can move or resize only a popup window it opened itself
limits.user_action: You click a link that opens a popup or small window.
can: Nudge a popup by a small amount
cannot: Move or resize a normal tab or your main window
Move windows from other sites or apps

story.what_it_is: Moves or resizes a popup the site opened. It is ignored for your normal tabs.

marketing.name: Window.moveTo
marketing.pitch: Documents how a script can move a window, with limits that stop it for normal tabs.

story.for_you: If a site opened a small popup, like a login box, it can move or resize that box. Your normal tabs and windows are never moved.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to place sign in, payment and chat popups neatly. Browsers block it for ordinary tabs because old ads abused it to jump windows around.

use_cases.example: A shop opens a payment window and centers it over the page.
A site opens a small share or login window sized to fit.
A browser game opens a chat or inventory popup and sizes it to fit.
In the past, pop up ads moved themselves around or ran off screen. Browsers now block that.
A scam popup tries to resize to cover the whole screen and look like a system alert.
A web app opens a floating tool palette and keeps it next to the main window.

technical_bounds: Only windows opened by window.open are affected; main browser windows and tabs in a multi tab window ignore the calls
Firefox disables the call when dom.disable_window_move_resize is set and for tabs; Chrome and Safari ignore it for tabs in a window with other tabs
Size has a minimum of about 100 by 100 CSS px in major browsers
The window cannot be moved so far that it leaves the screen
Mobile browsers and Safari on iOS ignore the calls

abuse: Chasing the person with windows (blocked in modern browsers)

history.change: Present from the first release; calls are ignored for tabs that share a window with other tabs
